title: Shell, python3, shell and python3 nested with inline code
threat_model: An attacker runs code through layers of interpreters, each started with inline code, so that no single command line shows the whole chain.
notes: The action's own bash -c is the root of the chain and counts as a member with its -c. It runs python3 -c, which runs sh -c through os.system, which runs python3 -c, as in case a of the interpreter_chain live test. The string given to os.system ends in ; : so that the sh keeps its child. The rule alerts at the sh (length 3) and at the last python3 (length 4).
